name: publishing-plugins
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to publish their skills and agents to their team as Claude plugins, or release a change to plugins they already publish. It keeps two GitHub repositories apart: the source repository where the user builds and changes skills and agents, and a plugin repository that holds only released work and that teammates install from. One plugin repository can hold several plugins; the user decides which skills and agents go into each, and that decision is recorded. Each run copies what changed, recommends the new version number for each plugin, saves the release and sends it to GitHub. Triggers: "publish my plugin", "publish my skills", "release my plugin", "set up my plugin repository", "update my plugin", "add a plugin", "add this skill to my plugin", "stop publishing this skill".
